omlx_version_note: Task brief assumed oMLX 0.6.4; actual installed version measured via `omlx --version` is 0.7.0rc1. Recorded as measured, not corrected to the assumed value.
port_note: 8000 is owned by an unrelated running process (verified via `lsof -i :8000` before start) and was not touched; 8010 was free (verified via `lsof -i :8010` returning no rows) and used instead.

auth.key_source: ~/.omlx/settings.json auth.api_key, read into a shell variable, never echoed, never written to any command line log or evidence file

start_command: omlx serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010 --model-dir ~/.kubemetal/models --log-level info (backgrounded, no --api-key on the command line)
